title: Code-Switching Red-Teaming: LLM Evaluation for Safety and Multilingual Understanding
benchmark_measurement: The paper's evaluation included non-adversarial queries about general knowledge from the MMMLU benchmark, which covers subjects like 'world religions' to test the models' comprehension abilities.
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. 'World religions' was mentioned as one of the general knowledge topics from the MMMLU benchmark used for testing non-adversarial comprehension, but results were not broken down by topic.
